a.lede: EA is closing BioWare and its Edmonton studio after deciding not to move forward with early development of the next Mass Effect.
a.title: EA is closing BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age, after more than 30 years

b.lede: BioWare, the legendary studio behind RPGs like Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, is shutting down, the company confirmed in a statement.
